name: @tradrl/audit
description: The platform-wide who-did-what-when audit service (Work Order T043): the PlatformAuditRecord chain — actor (principal ref), action (closed enumerable vocabulary: access, observability reads, config/policy publication, credential lifecycle refs, incidents, kill switch, releases), object ref, injected at-instant, tenant/project scope, L15 lineage block — append-only and chain-verified law-for-law with T040's audit.ts (identity-skeleton seed, contiguous sequences, fnv1a32Hex chainHead folds, content-addressed 'pau:' ids, duplicate object ref -> typed audit_rewrite, tamper/truncate/reorder -> audit_rewrite, NO removal or update API). COMPLEMENT, NOT DUPLICATE: T040 owns consequential submissions; this trail owns platform-level actor actions and references T040 records ONLY as opaque { kind, auditId, tenant, project } refs — the complement test byte-scans serialized platform records to prove no T040 payload is copied in. The credential-opacity trip wire runs over every record. The contract package @tradrl/observability is consumed via relative source imports (the services/execution-gateway precedent — no lockfile-touching workspace edge). RE-ENTRY COMPLETION: replayPlatformAuditTrail (the determinism proof’s audit-lane half — the re-append fold reproduces the trail byte-identically, replayTelemetryLog’s law mirrored); the action vocabulary is FROZEN at runtime and its closed-ness is a typed error path proven through BOTH entry points (the minter and the untrusted-input gate — invalid_field at platformAuditRecord.action, the message carrying the closed enumeration).
